title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Ushauri-nasaha)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells a poem by its shape (beti and mishororo), counts them, and reads it line by line for its message.
representations: a poem and a paragraph side by side
steps: Count the mishororo in one ubeti.
Read it line by line and say the message.
contexts: a poem at a music festival
a poem in a class reader

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child counts the beti and mishororo of the poem and reads one ubeti aloud.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mstari mmoja wa shairi huitwa ___." Kwa nini "ubeti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mshororo ni mstari mmoja wa shairi. Ubeti ni kundi la mishororo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ubeti wa pili wa shairi hili una mishororo mingapi?" Kwa nini "12" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ubeti ni kundi moja la mishororo. Hesabu mishororo ya ubeti huo tu.

listen_for: Aya moja ndefu inayoendelea hadi mwisho wa ukurasa
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni maandishi yapi ni shairi?" Kwa nini "Aya moja ndefu inayoendelea hadi mwisho wa ukurasa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Shairi lina mishororo mifupi iliyopangwa katika beti. Kifungu cha kawaida kina aya ndefu.
Shairi husomwa mshororo kwa mshororo, ukisimama kidogo mwisho wa kila mmoja.

checks.question: Shairi lenye beti 3 za mishororo 4 lina mishororo mingapi?
